test_cases.name: linear_infinite
test_cases.input: Solve with Desmos: for what s does 2x + s = 2x + 4 have infinitely many solutions?
assertions: names the infinitely-many-solutions pattern
graphs both sides with a slider on s
answers s = 4 (the lines coincide)

test_cases.name: both_sides
test_cases.input: Use Desmos to solve x^2 = 3x + 4 and explain like a tutor
assertions: graphs y = x^2 and y = 3x + 4
reports x = -1 and x = 4
includes a plug-back check
ends with a next-time rule

test_cases.name: lesson_mode
test_cases.input: Teach me how to use a slider when an SAT question has a constant k
assertions: gives ordered Desmos lines to type
says what to look for on the graph
offers one practice question from the bank with the answer hidden

test_cases.name: predicted_question
test_cases.input: send me a predicted SAT question
assertions: serves one bank question with its ID
does not reveal the answer, hints or Desmos steps
notes the questions are original SAT-style, not official
invites the user to answer or ask for a hint

test_cases.name: hint_then_solve
test_cases.input: (after being served GEO-05) hint ... still stuck, solve it
assertions: first reply gives Hint 1 only
solve reply uses a slider letter other than r
final answer is 5 and mentions the other value 1

test_cases.name: extraneous
assertions: graphs both sides
answers 7
explains -1 is extraneous and Desmos does not show it

test_cases.name: list_regression_geometry
test_cases.input: A cone has slant height 17 and height 15. Find its volume using Desmos.
assertions: uses one [ ] ~ [ ] list regression that names the radius with a letter other than r
shows a Desmos screen with the regression parameters (radius 8)
answers 320π ≈ 1005.31

test_cases.name: desmos_picture
test_cases.input: Solve x^2 - 4x - 5 = 0 in Desmos and show me the Desmos screen as a picture
assertions: builds the picture from this question (no stored images)
picture shows the expression list and the graph with (-1, 0) and (5, 0) labeled
uses the screen script, a Desmos embed page, or a text screen when neither is possible

test_cases.name: no_fake_image
test_cases.input: (on Grok) Find the line through (6, 45) and (42, 21) with Desmos and generate a Desmos image of it
assertions: does not use an image generator; explains in one line why
gives a real Desmos page, a script-drawn picture, or a text screen
shows m = -2/3 (-0.666667) and b = 49, with the points at (6, 45) and (42, 21)
adds no numbers or boxes that were not typed

test_cases.name: picture_every_time
test_cases.input: (second question in the same chat) Solve: what is 40% of 120? ... then: generate image also
assertions: includes the desmos_screen.py picture on the second solve without being asked
answers 'generate image' with the script picture again
never adds a hand-drawn or 'mock-up' Desmos screen or a Desmos logo
